goal: Find out whether ZachDFilms / His Story / Her Story-style 3D explainer shorts can be made on the HP, and what earns those channels their views. Rendering is solved; an LLM cannot stage a shot, so the next step is studying the reference channels before building any templates.
destination: undecided (deliberately) - no channel, long-form or client use chosen

decisions: The judge panel is the standard, not any single eye (mine said 4/7 where the panel said 1/7).
Study work lives in ~/blender-spike/study/, never in ~/clipvault/study/. Import from ClipVault and change nothing there.
Use ClipVault's YouTube token in memory only, and never the campaign client.
Never publish or redistribute downloaded video, and never copy the channels' phrasing.
One Blender at a time (out/.render.lock), since a render peaks at ~2 GB.
Nothing runs unattended: no timers, crons or services.
2026-09-15: the ChatGPT 'PS1 factory' spec is the templates design, not the next task. Study first. GPU-model phases cannot run on the HP (docs/ps1-factory-assessment.md).
2026-09-15: the Shorts cap is 180 s, not 60 s. His/Her Story Shorts run 61-180 s (only 45/50 videos are 60 s or less), and there the longer ones earn more.
open_questions: MVP v1 panel scores: 2.33/2.00/1.67/1.67/2.67 (one usable). Worth a v2 pass on the fix list in mvp/README.md before any of this is posted anywhere.
His Story's median bucket is ~2 months younger than its winners (2026-07-06 vs 04-28). Channel age is a real confound, so compare views/day as well as views.
Where would the content go: a channel, long-form, or client work? Deliberately undecided.
Close-out owed: rewrite findings.md to the round-3 state and clear the ~32 scratch files in /tmp.
